notes: Gen and CDI not computed: definition generality needs a language model: pip install 'ontoreview[cdi]'.

per_ontology.title: NCI Thesaurus OBO Edition
per_ontology.description: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt)is a reference terminology that includes broad coverage of the cancer domain, including cancer related diseases, findings and abnormalities. The NCIt OBO Edition aims to increase integration of the NCIt with OBO Library ontologies. NCIt OBO Edition releases should be considered experimental.

per_ontology.title: Medical Subject Headings
per_ontology.description: MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) is the National Library of Medicine's controlled vocabulary thesaurus. It consists of sets of terms naming descriptors in a hierarchical structure that permits searching at various levels of specificity. This thesaurus is used by NLM for indexing articles from biomedical journals, cataloguing of books, documents, etc.

per_ontology.title: Gender, Sex, and Sexual Orientation (GSSO) ontology
per_ontology.description: The Gender, Sex, and Sexual Orientation (GSSO) ontology has terms for annotating interdisciplinary information concerning gender, sex, and sexual orientation for primary usage in the biomedical and adjacent sciences.

release.title: Gender, Sex, and Sexual Orientation (GSSO) ontology

per_ontology.title: REPRODUCE-ME Ontology
per_ontology.description: The REPRODUCE-ME ontology is an extension of the PROV-O and the P-Plan ontology to describe a complete path of a scientific experiment. It expresses the REPRODUCE-ME Data Model using the OWL2 Web Ontology Language (OWL2). It provides a set of classes and properties to represent a scientific experiment including its computational and non-computational steps to track the provenance of results. It describes a complete path of a scientific experiment considering the use-case of biological imaging and microscopy experiments, computational experiments, including Jupyter notebooks and scripts. It describes an experiment and its data, agents, activities, plans, steps, variables, instruments, materials, and settings required for its reproducibility.

per_ontology.title: SNOMED CT (International Edition)
per_ontology.description: SNOMED CT or SNOMED Clinical Terms is a systematically organized computer processable collection of medical terms providing codes, terms, synonyms and definitions used in clinical documentation and reporting.

per_ontology.title: Allotrope Merged Ontology Suite
per_ontology.description: Allotrope Merged Ontology Suite

per_ontology.title: Gazetteer
per_ontology.description: A gazetteer constructed on ontological principles. The countries are actively maintained.

per_ontology.title: Ontology for Biomedical Investigations
per_ontology.description: An integrated ontology for the description of life-science and clinical investigations

per_ontology.title: Occupation Ontology
per_ontology.description: An ontology representing occupations. It is designed to facilitate harmonization of existing occupation standards, such as the US Bureau of Labor Statistics Standard Occupational Classification (US SOC), the International Standard Classification of Occupations (ISCO), the UK National Statistics Standard Occupational Classification (UK SOC), and the European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations (ESCO) of the European Union.

per_ontology.title: Research Organization Registry
per_ontology.description:
ROR (Research Organization Registry) is a global, community-led registry
of open persistent identifiers for research organizations. ROR is jointly
operated by California Digital Library, Crossref, and Datacite.

per_ontology.title: Semanticscience Integrated Ontology
per_ontology.description: The Semanticscience Integrated Ontology (SIO) provides a simple, integrated ontology of types and relations for rich description of objects, processes and their attributes.

per_ontology.title: terms4FAIRskills
per_ontology.description: A terminology for the skills necessary to make data FAIR and to keep it FAIR.

per_ontology.title: Ontology for the Anatomy of the Insect SkeletoMuscular system (AISM)
per_ontology.description: The AISM contains terms used in insect biodiversity research for describing structures of the exoskeleton and the skeletomuscular system. It aims to serve as the basic backbone of generalized terms to be expanded with order-specific terminology.

release.title: Ontology for the Anatomy of the Insect SkeletoMuscular system (AISM)

per_ontology.title: Ontology of bioinformatics topics, operations, identifiers, and formats
per_ontology.description: EDAM is a simple ontology of well established, familiar concepts that are prevalent within bioinformatics, including types of data and data identifiers, data formats, operations and topics. EDAM provides a set of terms with synonyms and definitions - organised into an intuitive hierarchy for convenient use.

release.title: Ontology of bioinformatics topics, operations, identifiers, and formats

per_ontology.title: Experimental Factor Ontology
per_ontology.description: The Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) provides a systematic description of many experimental variables available in EBI databases, and for external projects such as the NHGRI GWAS catalogue. It combines parts of several biological ontologies, such as anatomy, disease and chemical compounds. The scope of EFO is to support the annotation, analysis and visualization of data handled by many groups at the EBI and as the core ontology for OpenTargets.org

per_ontology.title: Environment Ontology
per_ontology.description: An ontology of environmental systems, components, and processes.

per_ontology.title: Food Ontology
per_ontology.description: A broadly scoped ontology representing entities which bear a “food role”. It encompasses materials in natural ecosystems and agriculture that are consumed by humans and domesticated animals. This includes any generic (unbranded) raw or processed food material found in processing plants, markets, stores or food distribution points. FoodOn also imports nutritional component and dietary pattern terms from other OBO Foundry ontologies to support interoperability in diet and nutrition research

per_ontology.title: Minimum Information about any (x) Sequence (MIxS) standard
per_ontology.description: An OWL representation of the Minimum Information for any (x) Standard (MIxS), managed by the Genomic Standards Consortium. This file is released by the Genomic Standards Consortium (GSC; https://www.gensc.org/) for use by anyone handling data or information about biological sequences.

release.title: Minimum Information about any (x) Sequence (MIxS) standard

per_ontology.title: Hymenoptera Anatomy Ontology
per_ontology.description: A structured controlled vocabulary of the anatomy of the Hymenoptera (bees, wasps, and ants)

per_ontology.title: Molecular Interactions Controlled Vocabulary
per_ontology.description: A structured controlled vocabulary for the annotation of experiments concerned with protein-protein interactions.

per_ontology.title: Mass spectrometry ontology
per_ontology.description: A structured controlled vocabulary for the annotation of experiments concerned with proteomics mass spectrometry.

per_ontology.title: Oral Health and Disease Ontology
per_ontology.description: The Oral Health and Disease Ontology is used for representing the diagnosis and treatment of dental maladies.

per_ontology.title: Ontology for MIRNA Target
per_ontology.description: Ontology to establish data exchange standards and common data elements in the microRNA (miR) domain

per_ontology.title: Ontology for Modeling and Representation of Social Entities
per_ontology.description: The Ontology for Modeling and Representation of Social Entities (OMRSE) is an OBO Foundry ontology that represents the various entities that arise from human social interactions, such as social acts, social roles, social groups, and organizations.

release.title: Ontology for Modeling and Representation of Social Entities

per_ontology.title: Scientific Evidence and Provenance Information Ontology
per_ontology.description: An ontology for representing the provenance of scientific claims and the evidence that supports them.

release.title: Scientific Evidence and Provenance Information Ontology

per_ontology.title: Space Life Sciences Ontology
per_ontology.description: The Space Life Sciences Ontology is an application ontology and is intended to support the operation of NASA's Life Sciences Data Archive and other systems that contain space life science research data.

per_ontology.title: TransformON
per_ontology.description: A domain ontology on food and bioproduct processing and characterization that is a specialization of the PO2 ontology (Process and Observation Ontology).

per_ontology.title: Teleost taxonomy ontology
per_ontology.description: An ontology covering the taxonomy of teleosts (bony fish)

per_ontology.title: Uberon multi-species anatomy ontology
per_ontology.description: An integrated cross-species anatomy ontology covering animals and bridging multiple species-specific ontologies

per_ontology.title: Vertebrate Breed Ontology
per_ontology.description: Vertebrate Breed Ontology is an ontology created to serve as a single computable resource for vertebrate breed names.

per_ontology.title: Vertebrate Taxonomy Ontology
per_ontology.description: Comprehensive hierarchy of extinct and extant vertebrate taxa.

per_entity.label: Age Criterion
per_entity.definition: Candidate must be within the prescribed pre-pubescent age range.

per_entity.label: Architectural Element
per_entity.definition: Carved or constructed component of an architectural structure (e.g., Gajur, Torana, Tundal)

per_entity.label: Architectural Structure
per_entity.definition: Physical structures built for religious, social, or civic purposes. Links to events of production, use, custody, and documentation.

per_entity.label: Architectural Style
per_entity.definition: A vocabulary of architectural styles for South Asian heritage, mapped to CIDOC E55 Type.

per_entity.label: Archival Record
per_entity.definition: Government or institutional administrative record

per_entity.label: Assertion Subject
per_entity.definition: Any HeritageGraph entity or event that may be the subject of an assertion.

per_entity.label: Calendar System
per_entity.definition: Calendar reckoning system with conversion rules for multi-calendar temporal reasoning

per_entity.label: Caste Group
per_entity.definition: Hereditary social group (Jati) with specific ritual roles and occupational duties

per_entity.label: Chaitya
per_entity.definition: Buddhist votive shrine (chaitya); votive stupa form found across the Kathmandu Valley.

per_entity.label: Chariot Festival
per_entity.definition: Festival involving ceremonial chariot procession (e.g., Rato Machhindranath Jatra)

per_entity.label: Condition Type
per_entity.definition: Controlled vocabulary for the physical condition of heritage objects and structures.

per_entity.label: Consecration
per_entity.definition: Ritual event that transforms an object into a sacred vessel (e.g., Prana Pratistha for Murti)

per_entity.label: Container
per_entity.definition: Root container for cultural heritage data instances. PLACEMENT RULE: put each instance in the most specific collection available (e.g. a Festival in festivals, not ritual_events; a Person in persons, not actors); broader collections exist for instances of the general classes only.

per_entity.label: Data Custodian
per_entity.definition: Institution or person currently responsible for stewarding heritage data.

per_entity.label: Data Source
per_entity.definition: Original source from which heritage information was derived

per_entity.label: Date Precision
per_entity.definition: Controlled vocabulary for the temporal precision of recorded heritage dates.

per_entity.label: Deity
per_entity.definition: Divine conceptual entity in Hindu, Buddhist, or syncretic traditions. Distinct from physical representations (Murti) and ritual presences.

per_entity.label: Dharmashala
per_entity.definition: Pilgrim lodge operated by a Guthi organization

per_entity.label: Dhunge Dhara
per_entity.definition: Stone spout (hiti) with carved imagery, used for ritual bathing and daily water supply

per_entity.label: Documentation Activity
per_entity.definition: Activity that records information about a heritage entity or event and may generate information objects or assertions. It aligns CIDOC CRM documentation practices with prov:Activity.

per_entity.label: Enshrinement
per_entity.definition: Event of installing a deity's murti or symbol within a temple sanctum

per_entity.label: Existence Status
per_entity.definition: Controlled vocabulary for whether a heritage structure still exists physically.

per_entity.label: Fearlessness Assessment
per_entity.definition: The 'fearlessness test' popularly described (animal heads, masked dancers in darkness). Its historical and contemporary practice is DISPUTED -- some former Kumaris contest how it is described. Represented as an assessment whose accounts are source-attributed via has_assertion, NOT as a mandatory criterion.

per_entity.label: Festival
per_entity.definition: Large-scale community ritual event (Jatra) involving processions, music, and collective participation

per_entity.label: Field Survey Activity
per_entity.definition: The activity of measuring, photographing, or assessing a site in person.

per_entity.label: Field Survey Dataset
per_entity.definition: The structured data or report resulting from a field survey.

per_entity.label: Guthi
per_entity.definition: Endowed trust organization unique to Nepal, managing temples, rituals, and land through hereditary or voluntary membership

per_entity.label: Guthi Type
per_entity.definition: Controlled vocabulary of Guthi functional types (CRM E55_Type)

per_entity.label: Historical Event
per_entity.definition: Major event affecting heritage structures or ritual life (earthquake, epidemic, political transition, fire, flood).

per_entity.label: Horoscope Compatibility Criterion
per_entity.definition: Candidate's horoscope must be compatible with the city and ruling authority.

per_entity.label: Iconographic Object
per_entity.definition: Sacred visual art objects that depict or embody deities through iconographic conventions

per_entity.label: Information Object
per_entity.definition: A recorded piece of information about heritage

per_entity.label: Kumari Enthronement Event
per_entity.definition: Ritual installing a selected girl into the Kumari role and residence, activating the tenure (distinct from selection, which chooses her, and retirement, which ends it).

per_entity.label: Kumari House
per_entity.definition: God-house residence of a Kumari during tenure (e.g., Kumari Ghar, Kathmandu). Specialised ReligiousStructure.

per_entity.label: Kumari Lifecycle Event
per_entity.definition: Abstract event that bounds a KumariTenure (selection, enthronement, or retirement). Each concrete subclass requires exactly one tenure edge via slot_usage: initiated_tenure (selection), ended_tenure_of (retirement), or bounds_tenure itself (enthronement).

per_entity.label: Kumari Retirement Event
per_entity.definition: Ritual or administrative event that formally ends a Living Goddess tenure, returning the person to secular status. Common triggers: first menstruation, injury causing blood loss, serious illness.

per_entity.label: Kumari Role
per_entity.definition: The role/office of Kumari (living-goddess embodiment) that a person assumes for the duration of a KumariTenure. The role is the type; the tenure is the time-bounded holding of it; the person is the holder.

per_entity.label: Kumari Selection Event
per_entity.definition: Tantric ritual process of selecting a new Living Goddess from eligible candidates. Involves examination of 32 auspicious physical marks (lakshana), horoscope matching with the city and ruling authority, and tests of fearlessness (e.g., remaining calm among buffalo heads and masked dancers in darkness). Performed by committee of Vajracharya priests, royal priest (Raj Jyotish), and astrologer.

per_entity.label: Kumari Tenure
per_entity.definition: Time-bounded role where a person embodies a deity as Living Goddess (Kumari), residing at a specific god-house and supported by religious institutions. This class captures the unique Nepali tradition of living deity embodiment in young girls selected from Buddhist Shakya/Vajracharya families.

per_entity.label: Lineage Criterion
per_entity.definition: Candidate must belong to an eligible lineage (Shakya / Vajracharya Newar Buddhist family).

per_entity.label: Masked Dance
per_entity.definition: Festival featuring masked dancers embodying deities (e.g., Kartik Naach)

per_entity.label: Metadata
per_entity.definition: Dataset metadata information

per_entity.label: Murti
per_entity.definition: Consecrated statue of a deity, ritually activated to serve as divine presence (not merely depiction)

per_entity.label: Oral History Interview
per_entity.definition: The interaction event between a researcher and a knowledge holder.

per_entity.label: Oral History Recording
per_entity.definition: The recording or transcript of an oral history interview.

per_entity.label: Pati
per_entity.definition: Open-air pavilion for resting travelers

per_entity.label: Paubha
per_entity.definition: Traditional Newari scroll painting (thangka) with mandala and deity iconography

per_entity.label: Physical Heritage Thing
per_entity.definition: Union of the tangible heritage classes: architectural structures, iconographic objects, and standalone architectural elements. Used as the range of slots that apply to any physical heritage thing (production, custody, condition assessment).

per_entity.label: Physical Integrity Criterion
per_entity.definition: Candidate must have an unblemished body with no scars, wounds, or loss of blood/teeth.

per_entity.label: Pokhari
per_entity.definition: Pond or tank for water storage, ritual bathing, and ecological management

per_entity.label: Proposition
per_entity.definition: A single machine-readable proposition (subject - predicate - object) held true by an Assertion. Modelled as a singleton proposition set (CRMinf I4); the predicate is a URI/CURIE, the object either a heritage entity or a literal.

per_entity.label: Religious Structure
per_entity.definition: Architectural structure whose defining purpose is religious: enshrines a deity and/or is a locus of ritual activation. Abstract grouping for sacred structures across traditions (temple, stupa, chaitya).

per_entity.label: Religious Tradition
per_entity.definition: Religious or philosophical tradition (e.g., Hindu, Buddhist, Syncretic)

per_entity.label: Rest House
per_entity.definition: Community structures for travelers and pilgrims, maintained by Guthi organizations

per_entity.label: Ritual Assessment
per_entity.definition: A performed assessment carried out during Kumari selection. Modelled as an event (not a hard criterion) so that source-specific, possibly conflicting accounts of whether/how it was conducted attach as provenanced Assertions rather than being asserted as fact.

per_entity.label: Ritual Event
per_entity.definition: Intentional ritual activity that activates sacred space, invokes deities, and binds social groups

per_entity.label: Ritual Type
per_entity.definition: Controlled vocabulary of ritual and festival activity types in Kathmandu Valley living heritage.

per_entity.label: Sattal
per_entity.definition: Multi-story rest house (3-5 floors) with ritual and social functions

per_entity.label: Selection Criterion
per_entity.definition: An eligibility criterion a candidate must satisfy to assume the Kumari role. Modelled as explicit subclasses so 'what are the eligibility criteria?' is a subclass query, not free text.

per_entity.label: Stupa
per_entity.definition: Buddhist dome-shaped reliquary shrine with circumambulation and ritual activation (e.g., Boudhanath, Swayambhunath).

per_entity.label: Syncretic Relationship
per_entity.definition: Formalizes the syncretic equivalence between divine entities across different theological frameworks. Following CIDOC CRM E13, it treats syncretism as a propositional claim with associated epistemic authority and provenance.

per_entity.label: Syncretic Type
per_entity.definition: Controlled vocabulary for kinds of syncretic theological relationships between deities.

per_entity.label: Temple
per_entity.definition: Religious structure characterized by deity enshrinement and ritual activation. Legal designation (e.g. 'Ancient Monument' under Nepal law) is recorded per-instance via a governance assertion, not as a class criterion.

per_entity.label: Thirty Two Perfections Criterion
per_entity.definition: Candidate must exhibit the battis lakshana (thirty-two perfections/auspicious bodily marks).

per_entity.label: Verification
per_entity.definition: Process of cross-checking heritage claims against multiple sources

per_entity.label: Water Structure
per_entity.definition: Engineered water supply systems with ritual and civic significance
